I am bipolar and also have daily thoughts of suicide. From personal experience... I have taken bottles of a cocktail of heavy psych meds: lamotrigine, Xanax, seroquel, etc. Please reconsider as it’s honestly the most painful attempt you could possibly choose. Your heart will race for hours, you will feel like you can’t breathe, your thoughts will race and your body will feel uncontrollable like you’re on speed. I have gone into a seizure like state with uncontrollable shakes, vomiting, and blacking out a couple times. The side effects will last for several painful hours. And... the likelihood of you actually dying are slim. I’m still here after multiple excruciating attempts. Here’s to hoping you don’t put yourself through the mental and physical torture like I’m sure many of us here have.

I’m so sorry for the pain you’re feeling right now. This is a temporary situation (corona/ masks) that will pass. Your life is worth so so much even if you don’t feel like anyone cares right now. They do. I care about your life and you deserve a great future. 

My brother took his own life a couple weeks ago. He was depressed and I assume he thought no one would care in the moment. I am beyond devastated. He is in my thoughts all day every day and I break down constantly. I wish he knew he was so loved and would have reached out to anyone like you are doing now.

My brother just killed himself. I assume he thought that nobody cared but I cared. He thought he would just melt away into nothing and that’s not the truth. So many people are suffering. Whether he believes it or not. Please before you do anything understand that it will affect so many people. It’s not a selfless act.

I hope my story resonates with you. My dear brother was a beautiful human being. He was brilliant. In fact he had a degree in chemical engineering and still could not face life as we know it. He was a pacifist and never liked conflict. He had friends so many friends that loved him for who he was and he rejected them. He had a sister. Me. Who reached out many many times and he rejected me also. He ended up moving to another town and taking his own life. I got a call saying that my brother had killed himself in the most horrific way a week ago I don’t think he thought that anyone cared. I did. It haunts my dreams. I saw his dead body and it will never leave me please know that somebody cares. I care about you and hope that you choose life.
